beforeCritique: The before header medallion was a mostly empty flat blue disc with a small shield, unlike the approved layered metallic ring and prominent shield.
Before frames used rounded boxes and corner overlays, with repetitive coarse diagonal panel stripes and little continuous chamfered rail detail.
Broad side-profile helmets crowded the centre field, VS and lower typography; approved equipment is narrower, taller and closer to upright three-quarter views.
Before text used heavy narrow condensed copy everywhere; the reference separates broad block headings from lighter readable table copy.
Before diamonds had too few broad facets; backdrop lighting and active controls lacked the approved concentrated white/cyan emission.
iterationChallenges: An early rebuilt candidate was challenged for underlit selected Ladder/AFC controls and a wrapping Team details label. Those issues were corrected before this freeze.

The next artwork review challenged broad equipment pose and dark rail emission rather than inheriting old approval. Continuous white/cyan rails, native upright equipment and independent genuine team marks were reviewed after those changes.
Candidate 1 was revoked after a WebKit motion failure. This acceptance binds only to candidate 2 raw manifest 674253c9, with both passed common browser reports and the 12 final original captures.

afterTopToBottom.finding: Approved diamond/gold Project Dollar branding and green bag remain crisp original native artwork. Blue stadium light arc replaces the wrong ambient football imagery without modifying shared Home artwork.

A detailed local vector chrome/cyan segmented ring now surrounds the enlarged genuine NFL SVG. Cardinal emission hits, fine rim lines and radial ticks remain sharp in both engines. Vector control outlines and chevrons show consistent native edge quality.

Continuous chamfered gold/cyan rails replace rounded corner overlays. Pale white/cyan emission is strong, restrained dark diagonal glass facets sit inside the frame, and genuine AFC/NFC SVG paint is not cropped or warped. Tables and separate team marks remain crisp.

Locally authored multi-facet SVG crystals are sharp at small and large use sizes, with localized glints placed away from readable copy. View-all and matchup edge ornament quality is materially improved.

Native 1254-square upright black/gold and pearl white/blue equipment renders without stretching. Taller narrow face cages, the central green pitch and the VS gap are visible. Genuine independent team mark overlays sit on blank shell panels, clear of face openings and hardware. Edges and alpha transitions look clean in Chromium and WebKit at both phone widths.

Broad squared Teko headings and lighter Roboto Condensed copy match the hierarchy more closely. Native font edges, passing/rushing/receiving headers, all five player rows and TD columns are legible in the full-content and untouched native bottom captures.

Continuous matching frame, sharp vector navigation icons and readable footer remain inside the viewport at both widths. No image clipping, new raster pixelation or engine-specific asset rendering defect was visible.

fonts.licensing: SIL Open Font License 1.1 copied adjacent to each local font; original copyright retained. No declared reserved font name in either source license.
fonts.processing: Native variable fonts subset to Latin and punctuation, then compressed to WOFF2 with fontTools; no font distortion or raster replacement.

equipmentProvenance.classification: Generated decorative unbranded football equipment edited from existing local decorative equipment using image_gen. Not official equipment photography, an authentic event photograph, a verified team helmet model, or a player image.
equipmentProvenance.transform: Native-size WebP compression only; no upscaling or artificial high-resolution claim.
equipmentProvenance.teamMarks: Existing genuine local Pittsburgh and Indianapolis marks independently overlaid; no generated official marks or faces.

performanceSupport.qualification: Earlier read-only request audit validates unchanged owned assets and dimensions. An authorized motion writer changed unrelated runtime bytes during that audit, so it is supporting asset evidence rather than this final common-source QA receipt. Both final common reports independently bind to the frozen 216-file manifest.

limitations: Qualitative fidelity is materially improved, not registered pixel identity: crystal microfacets, localized reflections, equipment model details and animation phase differ from the illustrative render.
Source-backed fixture facts and player statistics may differ from the reference sample data; no invented values are used to create a visual match.
WebKit and Chromium emulation is not a physical iPhone, actual Safari UI or a measured hardware 60fps claim.
Full-content captures temporarily unroll the real app internal scroller; untouched top and native bottom captures supply normal viewport evidence.
The generated decorative helmets are accurately classified and should not be presented as authentic team equipment photographs.
